text:
maria: Heads-up — I'm prototyping a 'noise suppression' feature for SLO alerts in the Console. Goal: reduce churn from low-signal SLOs without hiding real incidents. Thoughts?
kevin: Love it. We need both time-based quiet windows and an adaptive suppression (e.g., short flurries get squashed).
sophia: Agree. Also important: surface why an alert was suppressed in the UI (audit trail). Don't want teams to think alerts disappeared.
oliver: UX note — add an explicit badge: "suppressed (reason)" and a link to expand history. Otherwise folks will file pager tickets.
jess: How does this interact with routing? If suppressed alerts still count towards escalation counts we need to be careful.
maria: Right — my current idea: suppression = no notifications, but still recorded in telemetry and rollups. Only escalations bump up SLO incident counters.
sophia: Maybe compute a "noise_score" per route. Example heuristic: (unique_resource_hits / burst_duration) * (severity_weight). Lower score => eligible for auto-mute.
kevin: Example config draft:```json
{"slo_id":"latency_v2","severity":"warning","noise_tolerance_secs":120,"quiet_hours":{"start":"22:00","end":"06:00","tz":"UTC"},"group_by":["route","team"],"escalate_on":3}
```
maria: Nice. Also consider an opt-in "binning" mode: group similar alerts into a single summary notification that links to grouped traces.
ria: For escalation logic I'd prefer "distinct_hosts" threshold instead of just count — reduces noisy single-host blips.
oliver: On the Console side, we should let teams preview the expected notification volume change before enabling suppression. Maybe a simulation mode showing "would have suppressed X alerts last week".
jess: +1 on simulation. Ops will want to see false-negative risk. Add a short sample rate chart and playbook pointer.
deploy-bot: Deploy completed: feature/alerts-suppression-ux -> staging (build 2026.03.10.21) — no errors.
sophia: After deploy, please run the simulation for the last 7 days for the top 10 noisy SLOs and post results here. Metrics to show: notifications_saved, incidents_missed(est), avg_suppress_duration.
maria: Action items: (1) kevin/sophia to iterate heuristic and config, (2) oliver to mock UI badge/preview, (3) jess/ ria to define escalation vs telemetry counters, (4) me to add audit log entry schema. I'll drop PR and a sample dashboard tomorrow. :thumbsup:
kevin: I'll start on a simple PoC script that computes noise_score from recent telemetry.
oliver: I'll share a Figma link once mockups are ready.
maria: Thanks all — aim to demo in Monday eng-platform sync.
